# NCode Trademarks

The names and marks of NCode Group are not covered by this repository's Apache License 2.0. The names NCode, NCode Group
and NCode Identity and the marks are trademarks of NCode Group. The marks' artwork, every file in
[logo/](logo/README.md), is also copyright NCode Group, all rights reserved. This page says how you may use them.

## What It Covers

- The names: **NCode**, **NCode Group** and **NCode Identity**, and the name of any other NCode product.
- The marks: the `{N}` mark and the `{id}` mark, alone, with a wordmark, on a tile or in any other form, and every
  file in [logo/](logo/README.md).

The Apache License 2.0 covers this repository's code, tokens, stylesheets, braces, NCode's own icons and themes. A brace
alone, as [brace/](brace/) draws it for the stylesheets, is a part of the system and no mark: a mark is a brace pair
with its letters between them. The license's section 6 grants no permission to use the licensor's trade names,
trademarks, service marks or product names, beyond describing where a work comes from. The fonts in [fonts/](fonts/) are
copyright their authors and keep their own license, the SIL Open Font License 1.1. The icons in [icons/](icons/) taken
from Lucide keep Lucide's licenses, the ISC License and the MIT License, in `icons/LICENSE-Lucide.txt`.

## What You May Do Without Asking

Use the unmodified names and marks to refer to an NCode project, for example:

- in an article, a talk, a video or a book about it;
- in a package listing, a catalog or a comparison;
- in a "works with" or "built with" statement about your own project;
- in a link to it, or in documentation of your own that uses it.

Take the files from a release of this repository as they are, and follow [the guide's Marks section](guidelines/01-marks.md)
for clear space, size and color.

## What You May Not Do

- Alter a mark: recolor it outside its palette, stretch, outline or redraw it, set its braces in a font, or combine it
  with another mark.
- Use a name or a mark as the name or logo of your own product, company, service or domain, or as part of one.
- Use a name or a mark in a way that suggests NCode Group makes, sponsors or endorses your product.

## Modified Distributions

A fork or a modified distribution of an NCode project replaces the names and the marks with its own. The code's
license lets you change and share the code; it does not let a changed version carry NCode's names or marks. Keep the
copyright and license notices the code's license asks for.

## Copies Under Other Licenses

Other NCode repositories publish copies of the marks under their own licenses, and those copies stay under the license
they were published with:

- NCodeGroup/project-template, under its MIT License: the `{N}` logo kit in its `brand/` folder from v0.82.0 on, and
  the package icon `template/NCodeGroup.png`, which is that kit's blue NuGet tile from the same version on.
- Each project that template sets up as a .NET project that publishes NuGet packages under the template's icon, with
  the answers `stack: dotnet`, `nuget_package: true` and `package_icon: NCodeGroup.png`: that icon, as
  `NCodeGroup.png` at the project's root, under the project's own license. A template update leaves the file as it
  is, so a project set up before v0.82.0 keeps an earlier icon until it replaces the file itself.
- NCodeGroup/identity, under its Apache License 2.0: the `{id}` logo kit in its `brand/` folder.

The marks in this repository are released under the terms on this page.

## Ask

For any other use, open an issue in [NCodeGroup/brand](https://github.com/NCodeGroup/brand/issues) that says what you
want to do. Report a security problem privately instead, as [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) says.
